(async function () {
  const checks = [], $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
  const check = (value, label) => { if (!value) throw Error(label); checks.push(label); };
  const until = async (predicate) => { const end = Date.now() + 10000; while (!await predicate()) { if (Date.now() > end) throw Error("Timed out: " + predicate); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 25)); } };
  const requests = () => fetch("/fixture/requests").then((response) => response.json());
  const mode = (value) => fetch("/fixture/mode", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(value) });
  const tab = () => document.querySelector('[data-tab="tasks"]');
  const card = (id) => document.querySelector('[data-task-id="' + id + '"]');
  const action = (id, name) => card(id)?.querySelector('[data-task-action="' + name + '"]');
  const settingsFields = ['main', 'develop', 'featurePrefix', 'hotfixPrefix', 'releasePrefix'];
  const setSettings = (values) => { for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) $('task-settings-' + key).value = value; };
  const openSettings = async () => { $('tasks-settings').click(); await until(() => $('task-settings-dialog').open && !$('task-settings-save').disabled); };
  const settingsRequests = async (method) => (await requests()).filter((request) => request.path === '/api/tasks/settings' && request.method === method);
  const releaseSettings = (value) => fetch('/fixture/release-settings', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(value) });
  const selectProject = async (name) => {
    [...$('project-nav').querySelectorAll('button')].find((button) => button.querySelector('.nav-name')?.textContent === name).click();
    await until(() => !$('view-project').hidden && $('p-name').textContent === name);
    tab().click();
    await until(() => !$('tab-tasks').hidden && !$('tasks-refresh').disabled);
  };
  const returnToTasks = async () => {
    if (!$('view-session').hidden) $('s-crumb-project').click();
    await until(() => !$('view-project').hidden); tab().click();
    await until(() => !$('tab-tasks').hidden && $('tasks-new'));
  };
  await until(() => $('project-nav').querySelector('button') && $('kpis').children.length === 4);
  $('project-nav').querySelector('button').click();
  await until(() => !$('view-project').hidden && tab());
  check(!(await requests()).some((request) => request.path === '/api/tasks'), 'tasks load only when opened');
  tab().click();
  await until(() => !$('tab-tasks').hidden && !$('tasks-refresh').disabled);
  check(tab().classList.contains('active') || tab().getAttribute('aria-selected') === 'true', 'tasks tab selection');
  check($('tasks-list').textContent.length > 0, 'empty task guidance');
  $('tasks-new').click();
  await until(() => $('new-task-dialog').open && !$('task-create-submit').disabled);
  check($('task-type').value === 'feature', 'new task defaults to feature');
  check($('task-permission').value !== 'read-only', 'worker starts with editing permission');
  $('task-type').value = 'release'; $('task-type').dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
  check($('task-version').required && !$('task-version').disabled, 'release requires version');
  $('task-type').value = 'feature'; $('task-type').dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
  $('task-title').value = '로그인 버튼 수정';
  await mode({ holdCreate: true });
  $('new-task-form').requestSubmit($('task-create-submit'));
  await until(() => $('task-create-submit').disabled);
  $('new-task-form').requestSubmit($('task-create-submit'));
  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 60));
  check((await requests()).filter((request) => request.path === '/api/tasks' && request.method === 'POST').length === 1, 'duplicate create submit is blocked');
  await fetch('/fixture/release', { method: 'POST' });
  await until(() => !$('new-task-dialog').open && !$('view-session').hidden);
  await returnToTasks();
  await until(() => card('task-1'));
  check(card('task-1').textContent.includes('feature/task-1') && card('task-1').textContent.includes('develop'), 'created task shows GitFlow branch and target');
  check(action('task-1', 'open-session'), 'task links its session');
  action('task-1', 'finish').click();
  await until(() => $('finish-task-dialog').open);
  $('task-finish-message').value = 'fix: 로그인 버튼 수정';
  $('task-finish-description').value = '버튼 동작을 고칩니다.';
  $('task-finish-verification').value = '테스트 통과';
  $('finish-task-form').requestSubmit($('task-finish-submit'));
  await until(() => !$('finish-task-dialog').open && card('task-1')?.querySelector('a[href="https://github.com/fixture/repo/pull/42"]'));
  check(card('task-1').textContent.includes('리뷰'), 'finishing opens PR and enters review');
  const finished = (await requests()).find((request) => request.path === '/api/tasks/task-1/finish');
  check(finished?.body.message === 'fix: 로그인 버튼 수정' && finished.body.verification === '테스트 통과', 'finish sends commit and verification details');
  $('tasks-new').click();
  await until(() => $('new-task-dialog').open && !$('task-create-submit').disabled);
  $('task-title').value = '긴급 수정 <img src=x onerror="window.taskInjected=1">'; $('task-type').value = 'hotfix'; $('task-type').dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
  $('new-task-form').requestSubmit($('task-create-submit'));
  await until(() => !$('new-task-dialog').open && !$('view-session').hidden);
  await returnToTasks(); await until(() => card('task-2'));
  check(card('task-2').textContent.includes('hotfix/task-2') && card('task-2').textContent.includes('main'), 'hotfix targets main');
  check(!card('task-2').querySelector('img') && !window.taskInjected && card('task-2').textContent.includes('<img'), 'task titles render as text');
  await mode({ uncertain: true });
  action('task-2', 'finish').click(); await until(() => $('finish-task-dialog').open);
  $('task-finish-message').value = 'fix: 긴급 수정';
  $('finish-task-form').requestSubmit($('task-finish-submit'));
  await until(() => document.body.textContent.includes('중복 실행'));
  check((await requests()).filter((request) => request.path === '/api/tasks/task-2/finish').length === 1, 'uncertain write is never retried automatically');
  if ($('finish-task-dialog').open) $('finish-task-dialog').close();
  action('task-2', 'refresh').click();
  await until(() => card('task-2')?.textContent.includes('리뷰'));
  check(card('task-2').querySelector('a[href="https://github.com/fixture/repo/pull/42"]'), 'refresh reconciles uncertain PR');
  check((await requests()).filter((request) => request.path === '/api/tasks/task-2/finish').length === 1, 'recovery only reads PR state');
  await mode({ contextFailure: true }); $('tasks-refresh').click();
  await until(() => document.body.textContent.includes('원격 확인 실패'));
  check(card('task-1') && card('task-2'), 'remote failure preserves stored tasks');
  await mode({ contextFailure: false }); $('tasks-refresh').click();
  await until(() => !$('tasks-refresh').disabled);
  await openSettings();
  check($('task-settings-main').value === 'main' && $('task-settings-develop').value === 'develop', 'branch settings show current project defaults');
  check(settingsFields.every((key) => $('task-settings-' + key).required && $('task-settings-' + key).maxLength === 200), 'all branch settings require values within the shared length limit');
  $('task-settings-develop').value = 'Canceled'; $('task-settings-cancel').click();
  await openSettings();
  check($('task-settings-develop').value === 'develop' && (await settingsRequests('PUT')).length === 0, 'canceling branch settings does not save edits');
  $('task-settings-cancel').click();
  await mode({ settingsReadFailure: true }); $('tasks-settings').click();
  await until(() => $('task-settings-error').textContent.includes('설정 읽기 실패'));
  check($('task-settings-save').disabled && settingsFields.every((key) => $('task-settings-' + key).disabled), 'failed settings load cannot overwrite project settings');
  $('task-settings-cancel').click(); await mode({ settingsReadFailure: false });
  $('tasks-new').click(); await until(() => $('new-task-dialog').open);
  $('task-title').value = '보존할 작업 제목';
  const readCount = (await settingsRequests('GET')).length;
  await mode({ holdSettingsRead: true }); $('task-create-settings').click();
  await until(async () => (await settingsRequests('GET')).length > readCount);
  check($('task-settings-dialog').open && $('task-settings-save').disabled && $('task-settings-develop').disabled, 'settings opened during task creation wait for project settings');
  await releaseSettings({ read: true }); await until(() => !$('task-settings-save').disabled);
  const custom = { main: 'Main', develop: 'Develop', featurePrefix: 'Feature/', hotfixPrefix: 'Hotfix/', releasePrefix: 'Release/' };
  setSettings(custom);
  await mode({ holdSettingsSave: true });
  $('task-settings-form').requestSubmit($('task-settings-save'));
  await until(() => $('task-settings-save').textContent.includes('저장 중'));
  check($('task-settings-cancel').disabled && settingsFields.every((key) => $('task-settings-' + key).disabled), 'settings controls remain disabled while saving');
  $('task-settings-form').requestSubmit($('task-settings-save'));
  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 60));
  check((await settingsRequests('PUT')).length === 1, 'duplicate settings save is blocked');
  const saved = (await settingsRequests('PUT'))[0];
  check(saved.search.includes('C%3A%2Ffixture') && JSON.stringify(saved.body.settings) === JSON.stringify(custom), 'settings save sends case-sensitive names for the active project');
  await releaseSettings({ save: true });
  await until(() => !$('task-settings-dialog').open && !$('tasks-refresh').disabled);
  check($('new-task-dialog').open && $('task-title').value === '보존할 작업 제목', 'saving nested settings preserves the task creation form');
  check($('task-branch-preview').textContent === 'Develop에서 Feature/<작업ID>-<이름> 생성 → Develop으로 PR', 'feature preview uses custom case-sensitive branch settings');
  $('task-type').value = 'hotfix'; $('task-type').dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
  check($('task-branch-preview').textContent === 'Main에서 Hotfix/<작업ID>-<이름> 생성 → Main으로 PR', 'hotfix preview uses the configured main and prefix');
  $('task-type').value = 'release'; $('task-type').dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); $('task-version').value = '1.2.3'; $('task-version').dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));
  check($('task-branch-preview').textContent === 'Develop에서 Release/1.2.3 생성 → Main으로 PR', 'release preview uses the configured branches and prefix');
  $('task-create-cancel').click();
  check(card('task-1').textContent.includes('feature/task-1 → develop') && card('task-2').textContent.includes('hotfix/task-2 → main'), 'existing task cards retain their original GitFlow snapshot');
  await openSettings();
  check(settingsFields.every((key) => $('task-settings-' + key).value === custom[key]), 'reopening settings reloads the saved branch names');
  await mode({ settingsSaveFailure: true }); $('task-settings-develop').value = 'Invalid';
  $('task-settings-form').requestSubmit($('task-settings-save'));
  await until(() => $('task-settings-error').textContent.includes('브랜치 이름'));
  check($('task-settings-dialog').open && !$('task-settings-save').disabled && $('task-settings-develop').value === 'Invalid', 'failed settings save keeps edits available for correction');
  $('task-settings-cancel').click(); await mode({ settingsSaveFailure: false });
  await openSettings(); check($('task-settings-develop').value === 'Develop', 'failed save preserves the last committed settings'); $('task-settings-cancel').click();
  $('tasks-new').click(); await until(() => $('new-task-dialog').open);
  $('task-title').value = '사용자 브랜치 작업'; $('new-task-form').requestSubmit($('task-create-submit'));
  await until(() => !$('new-task-dialog').open && !$('view-session').hidden); await returnToTasks(); await until(() => card('task-3'));
  check(card('task-3').textContent.includes('Feature/task-3 → Develop'), 'new tasks use the saved branch names while old tasks remain unchanged');
  const beforeRead = (await settingsRequests('GET')).length;
  await mode({ holdSettingsRead: true }); $('tasks-settings').click();
  await until(async () => (await settingsRequests('GET')).length > beforeRead);
  await selectProject('Other');
  check(!$('task-settings-dialog').open && !card('task-1'), 'switching projects closes settings and clears unrelated tasks');
  await openSettings(); check($('task-settings-develop').value === 'develop', 'another project starts with its own branch settings');
  await releaseSettings({ read: true }); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 60));
  check($('task-settings-dialog').open && $('task-settings-develop').value === 'develop', 'late settings reads cannot overwrite another project dialog');
  setSettings({ main: 'Primary', develop: 'Integration' });
  const beforeSave = (await settingsRequests('PUT')).length;
  await mode({ holdSettingsSave: true }); $('task-settings-form').requestSubmit($('task-settings-save'));
  await until(async () => (await settingsRequests('PUT')).length > beforeSave);
  await selectProject('Fixture'); await openSettings();
  await releaseSettings({ save: true }); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 60));
  check($('task-settings-dialog').open && $('task-settings-main').value === 'Main' && $('task-settings-develop').value === 'Develop', 'late settings saves cannot close or overwrite another project dialog');
  $('task-settings-cancel').click(); await selectProject('Other'); await openSettings();
  check($('task-settings-main').value === 'Primary' && $('task-settings-develop').value === 'Integration', 'delayed saves update only their original project');
  $('task-settings-cancel').click(); await selectProject('Fixture'); await openSettings();
  check($('task-settings-main').value === 'Main' && $('task-settings-develop').value === 'Develop', 'custom GitFlow settings remain available after project navigation');
  return checks;
})()
